title: Breaking: Aangan mein shaadi!
format: Kitty Gang news bulletin on the Tulsi Vivah game: Ruhi anchors a TV-style 'breaking news' report, live reporters at each prize group, the Housie claim is the big story

experiment.hook: Ruhi as a TV anchor with her phone as the mic on the Tulsi Vivah home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'BREAKING: AANGAN MEIN SHAADI!' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Breaking news! Aaj Tulsi ji ki shaadi!'
experiment.variable: a familiar TV pattern as the glue: a 'BREAKING' anchor plus 'LIVE x/4' reporter chips (Ganna, Chunri, Diya, then the Tulsi claim on the game), so every cut is a handoff the viewer already knows from Hindi news, on top of the fast single-face cuts that won 11-18
experiment.hypothesis: the breaking-news voice every 30 to 55 year old knows by heart makes the 0 s line feel urgent and the handoffs feel like progress: skip under 55% (best 49.6), watched % above 21 (best 21), at least 1 share on Tulsi Vivah day when families are doing the puja

idea: On Tulsi Vivah, Ruhi reports the aangan shaadi like breaking news: Megha guards the ganna mandap but wants a bite, Tina's chunri is limited edition, Myra has the diya but no matchbox, Ishita claims the Tulsi group early, and Aditi, holding prasad, has actually won it.
beats: hook: breaking news, Tulsi ji ki shaadi / live 1/4: Megha at the ganna mandap / live 2/4: Tina's chunri / live 3/4: Myra's diya, no matchbox / live 4/4: the call on the game / turn: Ishita claims Tulsi early / reveal: Tulsi group is Aditi's / button: anchor asks Aditi, prasad first
logline: Ruhi reports Tulsi Vivah like TV news, and the quiet one wins the Tulsi group.
game: every live reporter gets distracted from the shaadi, and the loudest claim loses
caption: Aaj ki sabse badi khabar: aangan mein shaadi! Aap kis report mein ho: Ganna, Chunri, Diya ya Tulsi? Apni Tulsi Vivah wali saheli ko tag karo. Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein milte hain.

lines.text: Breaking news! Aaj Tulsi ji ki shaadi!
lines.say: ब्रेकिंग न्यूज़! आज तुलसी जी की शादी!

lines.text: Mandap ready! Bas ek ganna chakh loon?
lines.say: मंडप रेडी! बस एक गन्ना चख लूं?

lines.text: Laal chunri, asli gota. Limited edition.
lines.say: लाल चुनरी, असली गोटा। लिमिटेड एडिशन।

lines.text: Diya ready! Maachis kiske paas hai?
lines.say: दिया रेडी! माचिस किसके पास है?

lines.text: Aditi ji, desh jaanna chahta hai!
lines.say: अदिति जी, देश जानना चाहता है!
